summary: The PR adds get/set_antialiased methods to Text objects and adjusts backends accordingly. It resolves the issue without apparent regressions or compatibility breaks.

issues.description: The docstring for `set_antialiased` mentions that antialiasing will be determined by `text.antialiased` and the parameter `antialiased` will have no effect if the text contains math expressions. This could be clarified or expanded for better understanding.
